Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was changing lanes on the freeway in Katy, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling as I moved over, when a
vehicle in the lane I was entering sideswiped the passenger side of my car. The impact pushed my car toward the
median and I had to brake hard to regain control. I pulled onto the shoulder and waited for the other driver to stop, but
they kept going. I stayed in the car for a moment before stepping out, and my right knee was throbbing and stiff, so I
sat on the curb until help arrived. I have told this same account every time I have described what happened, to the
responding officer, to the adjuster, and to my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own
vehicle at the time. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I can provide photos of the
damage and my medical visit notes on request.
